summary: Audit of scripts/select-sanity-tests.py and scripts/coverage-policy.py confirms the gap: neither script has a dedicated test file, no existing test exercises their public functions indirectly, both contain pure deterministic logic independently testable without live services, and scripts/ is excluded from the coverage source path requiring sys.path injection in new tests. Full contract suite passed (93.07% statement, 84.44% branch coverage).

findings.dedicated_test_file_check: ls tests/ | grep -E 'test_select|test_coverage_policy|test_sanity' returned empty — no dedicated test file for either script exists in the test suite.
findings.indirect_coverage_check: grep -rl 'select_sanity_tests|coverage_policy|from scripts|import select' tests/ returned empty — no existing test imports or exercises these script functions indirectly.
findings.coverage_source_path: pyproject.toml [tool.coverage.run] source=['src/mac'] — scripts/ directory is NOT included; the coverage tool does not measure scripts/ at all.
findings.pytest_pythonpath: pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] pythonpath=['src'] — scripts/ is not on the Python path; tests must use sys.path.insert or importlib to import scripts/select-sanity-tests.py and scripts/coverage-policy.py.
findings.conftest_analysis: Root conftest.py provides portfolio measurement hooks (pytest_runtest_setup/logreport/sessionfinish) and coverage context switching — no fixtures relevant to script testing. tests/conftest.py provides postgres, soul-binding, and MAC CLI fixtures — none applicable to script unit tests.

select_sanity_tests_py.purity_assessment: select() is pure/deterministic when given an explicit changed-files list — it performs no I/O other than filesystem existence checks (Path.is_file()) on test file paths rooted at ROOT (repo root). _git_changed_files() and _codegraph_affected() are subprocess-dependent and would need monkeypatching or be avoided by passing --changed-file args directly to select(). All branching logic in select() (broad_paths, broad_prefixes, code_changes, canaries, mode selection) is independently exercisable by varying the changed-files input.

coverage_policy_py.purity_assessment: _percentage() is a pure arithmetic function with a zero-division guard. evaluate() is pure — it takes two dicts (coverage JSON and policy TOML content) and returns a deterministic result dict with no I/O or side effects. All branching (statement floor, branch floor, require_branch_measurement, zero-total edge cases, pass/fail status) is exercisable with synthetic input dicts.

tests/test_select_sanity_tests.py.purpose: Unit tests for scripts/select-sanity-tests.py — covers select(), _module_test_candidates(), and schema/mode logic
tests/test_select_sanity_tests.py.sys_path_approach: Use sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts')) and importlib.import_module or importlib.util.spec_from_file_location to load select-sanity-tests.py (filename contains hyphens, not valid as a bare import).

tests/test_coverage_policy.py.purpose: Unit tests for scripts/coverage-policy.py — covers _percentage(), evaluate(), and result structure
tests/test_coverage_policy.py.sys_path_approach: Use importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('coverage_policy', Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts' / 'coverage-policy.py') to load the module despite the hyphenated filename.

investigation.exact_gap: scripts/ is absent from both tool.coverage.run.source and tool.pytest.ini_options.pythonpath. Neither script has a dedicated test file (tests/test_select_sanity_tests.py and tests/test_coverage_policy.py do not exist). No existing test exercises these functions indirectly. Both scripts contain pure deterministic APIs (select(), _percentage(), evaluate()) that are fully testable with synthetic inputs and no live service dependencies.

tests.result: contract suite passed; 93.07% statement coverage (floor 90.00%), 84.44% branch coverage (floor 80.00%)

codegraph.reason: Investigation task only — no src/ code changes were made; scripts/ are outside the coverage source path; CodeGraph is not applicable for this read-only audit.

assumptions: The task explicitly requires NOT writing new test files — this evidence records findings only.
scripts/ requires sys.path injection or importlib.util.spec_from_file_location in new tests due to hyphenated filenames and exclusion from pytest pythonpath.
conftest.py fixtures (postgres, soul) are irrelevant to script unit tests; no new fixtures are needed for the recommended test files.
